slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: A project significantly larger than your usual scope can be a genuine growth opportunity, but it often requires resourcing beyond what current cash flow comfortably supports. Finance sized to the specific project can bridge that gap.

caption:
A project bigger than your usual scope is exciting, but it's worth being honest about whether it needs more than just extra hours, often it needs upfront resourcing that current cash flow wasn't built to absorb.

Finance sized specifically to the project can bridge that gap, letting you take on the opportunity without stretching the rest of the business thin.
